3.heading: EXT. SABA ELIOR’S COURTYARD — LATE MORNING

shot_details.title: Saba entertains the children
shot_details.action: SABA ELIOR sits beneath a fig tree, surrounded by several village children. He is repairing a sandal with one hand and gesturing grandly with the other.

dialogue.line: And so the little sparrow said to the great camel, “If your knees bend, perhaps your pride may also.”

audio.ambience: late morning courtyard air, fig leaves moving lightly, distant village lane sounds; no music

shot_details.title: The audience loosens as Miri arrives
shot_details.continuity: Continue the same moment from @Image 6: keep the lighting, positions, props, and character appearance exactly as in that frame; Saba remains beneath the fig tree with the children still present.
shot_details.action:
A few children giggle. Others are distracted. One pokes a beetle with a reed. Another tries to balance a fig on his nose.
Miri enters with the linen basket. She slows, listening.

dialogue.line: But the camel did not listen, because camels are very good at chewing and very poor at hearing wisdom.

audio.ambience: late morning courtyard air, faint village voices beyond the wall, insects, fig leaves; no music

shot_details.title: The hoop steals the crowd
shot_details.continuity: Continue the same moment from @Image 6: keep the lighting, positions, props, and character appearance exactly as in that frame; Miri is still holding the linen basket near the courtyard edge; Saba remains beneath the fig tree.
shot_details.action:
Miri smiles despite herself.
A GIRL spots a group of older children playing with a hoop in the lane.

shot_details.title: Children run off
shot_details.continuity: Miri and Saba remain in the courtyard.
shot_details.action: The children scatter after her, laughing.

shot_details.title: One listener left
shot_details.continuity: The children have just scattered out toward the lane.
shot_details.action:
Saba watches them go, amused, not offended.
Miri remains.

dialogue.line: Ah. One listener left. Either my story improved, or your feet forgot to follow the others.

audio.ambience: courtyard ambience opening toward a busier lane, fig leaves, distant children at play; no music
sfx: hoop rattling faintly in the lane
